preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
The number of elements n in each test case must be between 3 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 100 for a_i in a) and all(1 <= b_i <= 100 for b_i in b) and all(1 <= c_i <= 100 for c_i in c)
preconditions.description: All elements in sequences a, b, and c must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(a_i != b_i and a_i != c_i and b_i != c_i for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: For each index i, the elements a_i, b_i, and c_i must be distinct.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(p_i in {a_i, b_i, c_i} for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each element p_i in the output must be one of the values from the corresponding a_i, b_i, or c_i.

postconditions.expression: all(p_i != p[(i + 1) % n] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: No two adjacent elements in the output sequence must be equal, including the wrap-around from the last to the first element.
